tasks.title: Lecture #18
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk on environmental conservation.
tasks.transcript: Let’s talk the environmental issue that has to do with how common household products have changed. More and more products contain bacterial killing chemicals these days. These antibacterial chemicals aren’t just in product like soap. They are in all sorts of household cleaners and toothpaste. And if you think about it for second you will realize that most of those chemicals just end up going down the drain. But you are probably thinking that all that stuff go through a treatment plan that removes chemicals, right? After all that’s what happens to stuff that goes down the drain. Well, waste water is treated, but that doesn’t usually remove all the chemicals in it. The chemicals left in the treated water get into the aquatic environment. That is into the rivers, and streams where plants and fish and other animals live. Now to find out the affect of antibacterial chemicals on fresh water ecosystems, a study was done with algae, which are tiny plant like organisms. Different spices algae were taken to a lab and the expose to just a few antibacterial chemicals found in the streams. And guess what? In the experiment, the overall gross of algae and the number of spices dropped. This is not good and here is why. Algae are the base of the aquatic of food chain, which means that other organisms depend on them for food. So if the chemicals kill algae at the bottom of the food chain, the whole system is being disrupted.

questions.stem: What is the professor mainly discussing?

options.C: A threat to the aquatic environment
options.D: The increasing number of algae in rivers

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：教授主要讨论了什么？ 定位原文： The chemicals left in the treated water get into the aquatic environment. That is into the rivers, and streams where plants and fish and other animals live. Now to find out the affect of antibacterial chemicals on fresh water ecosystems, a study was done with algae... Algae are the base of the aquatic of food chain, which means that other organisms depend on them for food. So if the chemicals kill algae at the bottom of the food chain, the whole system is being disrupted. 选项分析： A. A rare species of algae（一种稀有的藻类）。讲话中提到藻类是为了研究抗菌化学物质的影响，但并未讨论藻类是否稀有，所以A选项错误。 B. The treatment of wastewater（废水的处理）。讲话虽提到废水处理，但指出处理无法去除所有化学物质，这是为了引出对水生环境的威胁，并非主要内容，所以B选项错误。 C. A threat to the aquatic environment（对水生环境的威胁）。讲话围绕家用产品中的抗菌化学物质进入水体后对藻类和水生食物链造成的威胁展开，因此C选项正确。 D. The increasing number of algae in rivers（河流中藻类数量的增加）。讲话中藻类数量在实验中是下降的，而非增加，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the professor, how have household products changed?

options.A: They are becoming more dangerous to the user.
options.B: They are encouraging the growth of algae in streams
options.C: They are being made with fewer chemicals.
options.D: They are being made to kill bacteria.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：根据教授，家用产品发生了怎样的变化？ 定位原文： More and more products contain bacterial killing chemicals these days. These antibacterial chemicals aren’t just in product like soap. They are in all sorts of household cleaners and toothpaste. 选项分析： A. They are becoming more dangerous to the user（它们对使用者变得更具危险性）。讲话未讨论对使用者的危险性，所以A选项错误。 B. They are encouraging the growth of algae in streams（它们促进了溪流中藻类的生长）。讲话指出化学物质会杀死藻类，而非促进其生长，所以B选项错误。 C. They are being made with fewer chemicals（它们在生产中使用的化学物质更少）。讲话指出越来越多的产品含有抗菌化学物质，说明化学物质在增加而非减少，所以C选项错误。 D. They are being made to kill bacteria（它们被生产出来是为了杀死细菌）。讲话明确指出越来越多的产品含有杀灭细菌的化学物质，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: What does the professor say about the treatment of waste water?

options.A: It does not remove all chemicals.
options.B: It encourages the growth of some bacteria.
options.C: It is not done on a regular basis.
options.D: It has been improved by new technologies

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：教授对废水处理有什么说法？ 定位原文： Well, waste water is treated, but that doesn’t usually remove all the chemicals in it. The chemicals left in the treated water get into the aquatic environment. 选项分析： A. It does not remove all chemicals（它无法去除所有化学物质）。讲话明确指出废水经过处理，但通常无法去除其中的所有化学物质，因此A选项正确。 B. It encourages the growth of some bacteria（它促进了某些细菌的生长）。基于讲话未提及处理过程会促进细菌生长，所以B选项错误。 C. It is not done on a regular basis（它没有定期进行）。讲话未讨论废水处理的频率，所以C选项错误。 D. It has been improved by new technologies（新技术对其进行了改进）。讲话未提及新技术的改进，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What is the subject mentioned by the professor?

options.A: The role of algae in the food chain
options.B: The effect of household chemicals on algae
options.C: The detection of chemicals in wastewater
options.D: The creation of safer household products

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：教授提到了什么主题？ 定位原文： Now to find out the affect of antibacterial chemicals on fresh water ecosystems, a study was done with algae, which are tiny plant like organisms. Different spices algae were taken to a lab and the expose to just a few antibacterial chemicals found in the streams. And guess what? In the experiment, the overall gross of algae and the number of spices dropped. 选项分析： A. The role of algae in the food chain（藻类在食物链中的作用）。讲话确实提到藻类是食物链的基础，但这是为了说明化学物质影响的重要性，并非教授主要提及的研究主题，所以A选项错误。 B. The effect of household chemicals on algae（家用化学物质对藻类的影响）。教授详细介绍了用藻类进行的实验，研究抗菌化学物质对藻类的影响，因此B选项正确。 C. The detection of chemicals in wastewater（废水中化学物质的检测）。讲话未讨论化学物质的检测方法，所以C选项错误。 D. The creation of safer household products（更安全家用产品的研发）。基于讲话未涉及产品研发，所以D选项错误
